name: Outline_Translucent_MainTex
kuro_shading_model: Kuro forward translucent base pass (lit: ambient View[299] + CB3 local-light loop, fog, pre-exposure)
kuro_asm: PS __105645 (Mone Down/Alpha/Glass_OL, Linnaea Alpha_OL, Luhesi test tubes; VS __272265 / __105649 == VS-B) and PS __133206 (MI_ERebeccaDrinkMd10011_OL; VS __133216 == VS-A), forward translucent

Emissive.kuro: material emissive (before the engine tail: max(.,0), View[285] scale, OOB)

Opacity.kuro: material opacity (o0.a before the Kuro primitive fade)

BaseColor.kuro: material base colour (lit by Kuro ambient View[299] and the forward light loop)

inputs.name: SelectionColor
inputs.note: engine selection tint; not in Material CachedExpressionData, compiled default 0

inputs.name: E_LinkCos1
inputs.note: float32 x / 360 (true division), * 0x40C90FDB, then CRT cosf (Kuro preshader)

inputs.name: E_LinkNegSin1
inputs.note: float32 x / 360 (true division), * 0x40C90FDB, then CRT sinf (Kuro preshader)

inputs.name: E_LinkCos2
inputs.note: float32 x / 360 (true division), * 0x40C90FDB, then CRT cosf (Kuro preshader)

inputs.name: E_LinkNegSin2
inputs.note: float32 x / 360 (true division), * 0x40C90FDB, then CRT sinf (Kuro preshader)

input_kinds.texture: Texture2D material parameter `param` (Texture Object pin); `default` = parent Material default texture
input_kinds.sampler: sampler paired with `texture`; ue_expr is the HLSL name inside the Custom node
input_kinds.scalar|vector: material parameter `param` (Kuro name), `default` = compiled/Material default; vector `channels` used
input_kinds.worldnormal|worldtangent: raw interpolated TangentToWorld rows (`channel` sign/bitangent), ue_expr given
input_kinds.interpolator: value produced in the VS by `source` (vertex_interpolators)
input_kinds.cpd: CustomPrimitiveData `index` (list = assembled vector), filled by UWuwaToonCharacterComponent
input_kinds.mpc: Material Parameter Collection `mpc` / `mpc_param` (Kuro asset default in `default`)
input_kinds.toonlight: ToonShadowLightData CB1 row `index` (float4); no recovered default (see note on [1].w bits)
input_kinds.view: View uniform field (ue_expr) or Kuro-only View member (ue_expr null, `kuro` row, explicit default)
input_kinds.primitive: Primitive data (ue_expr) or Kuro-only Primitive member (ue_expr null, explicit default)
input_kinds.output: out parameter, exposed as an additional Custom node output

inputs.name: ClipToTranslatedWorld
inputs.kuro: with PreViewTranslation rebuilds Kuro ClipToWorld View[8..11]

wpo.custom_node_code: return WuwaToonOutlineWPO_B(UV1, VertexColor, VertexTangentWS, VertexBitangentWS, VertexNormalWS, ObjectAxisScale, TranslatedWorldPosition, TranslatedWorldCameraOrigin, TranslatedWorldToClip, ClipToTranslatedWorld, PreViewTranslation, ClipToView00, ClipToView11, ViewSizeAndInvSize, KuroOutlinePixelScale, VertexGMinWidthFactor, OutlineClipWidth, OutlineHoldDistance, InnerOutlineMulti, InnerOutlineOffset, KuroEnablePrimitiveOffset, KuroPrimitiveOffset);
wpo.space: world-space offset vector (UE World Position Offset); positions fed in translated world

raster.kuro: bIsBackFace / BackFace=True: inverted hull, front faces culled (pipeline state, not in DXBC)
raster.ue_emulation: UE materials cannot cull front faces; use a flipped-winding outline mesh section, or two_sided with a front-face discard (kind frontface) — not part of the decompiled PS

resolve_note: Kuro draws these outlines in the forward translucent pass (one o0, no toon GBuffer, no toon resolve). The port returns the MATERIAL part only (BaseColor, Emissive, Opacity), verified bit-exact through the whole original o0 by splicing it into a 1:1 transpile of the original (tools/shaderdiff/roster_eyeoutline/outline_tdiff.py). The engine tail is NOT ported: Kuro primitive fade (Primitive[43]), vertex/volumetric fog, emissive max/scale/OOB, the ambient term BaseColor * View[299] (Kuro-only View member) and Kuro's forward local-light loop (wrapped half-Lambert toon lights, 9 float4 per light) - UE's own translucency lighting and fog replace them (approximation, not bit-exact).

ue_material.contract: entry returns FWuwaFXOutput {float3 Emissive; float Opacity;} plus out float3 BaseColor - no toon GBuffer, no WuwaToonResolve
ue_material.translucency_lighting_mode: TLM_SurfacePerPixelLighting (closest UE equivalent of Kuro forward lighting; not bit-exact)
ue_material.note: Kuro inverted-hull outline drawn translucent: cull front faces (flipped-winding section) as for the opaque outlines

roster_variant.notes: WPO: VS __272265 / __105649 SV_POSITION == VS-B __114157 and VS __133216 == VS-A __207702 (symbolic, vertex-fog loop removed); the registry pairs the A-family VS with Outline_Translucent_MainTex_A.
